summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist in monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py, exported it from monai/data/__init__.py, added a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection under Utilities in docs/source/data.rst, and added tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (four tests). Nothing was run or committed; line lengths were checked by awk and all are at most 120 columns. Choices made: absent image/label fields are left absent; a non-list value under the data key raises ValueError; a non-object top-level JSON is reported as a missing key.
